tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Moore Spaces] ↗ thm:cellular-singular-homology-isomorphic 1. ch2:2.40\group Cellular Homology

A Moore space $M(G,n)$ is a simply-connected CW complex for $n>1$ with $H_n(M(G,n))\cong G$ and reduced homology zero in other dimensions. For finitely generated $G$, wedge spheres and degree maps realize it; in general attach $(n+1)$-cells representing a free presentation of $G$. \end{example}
